title: UnityException: FindObjectsByType can only be called from the main thread.
notes: Fix 2026-11-28 by Yash (23dd974a86): Already fixed (daily sweep 2026-11-28): the 5 s offline data-init timeout completed the await on a .NET timer thread (CancelAfter + AttachExternalCancellation), so EnterOfflineSessionAsync's FindAnyObjectByType<MultiplayerSetup> ran off the main thread. 23dd974a86 (Ys-bleeding-edge, 2026-11-27) resumes every outcome on the main thread (AwaitWithTimeoutOnMainThread + AsMainThread). This sighting (2026-11-26 21:34 UTC) predates it. Not yet in bleeding-edge.

UnityException: FindObjectsByType can only be called from the main thread.
